exposure: Delphi consensus criteria for CSP classification
outcome: Need for repeated courses of methotrexate (MTX)
Surgical interventions (laparotomy, uterine artery embolization, and operative hysteroscopy)
cohort: 36 women diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) and treated with combined local and systemic methotrexate (MTX) between 2008 and 2021
finding: The depth of gestational sac herniation in cesarean scar pregnancy, as defined by the Delphi consensus criteria, is associated with different clinical outcomes, including β-HCG levels, need for additional treatment, and hospitalization duration.
